items.title: Patient-Reported Functional and Cosmetic Outcomes after Rhinoplasty with Autologous Versus Cadaveric Rib Cartilage Grafts
items.fact_zh: 129例鼻整形，自体肋33例、异体肋96例；随诊鼻塞评分自体组低14.0分，外形无差异。
items.take_zh: 自体肋换来的是通气不是外形；翻修率15.2%对24.0%区间跨零，别当优势讲。
items.scene_zh: 用异体肋省一块胸口疤，通气可能差一点，这个术前要说清。
items.fact_en: In 129 adults (33 autologous, 96 cadaveric rib grafts), autologous recipients averaged obstruction scores 14.0 points lower over follow-up (95% CI -24.2 to -3.9), with no significant difference in cosmetic scores or revisions (15.2% vs 24.0%).
items.take_en: Autologous rib bought better breathing, not a better-looking nose, and the revision gap is too imprecise to sell as an advantage.
items.first_affil: Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis, St. Louis, Missouri, USA

items.title: SMAS Plication Facelift and Platysmaplasty Under Tumescent Local Anesthesia: a 10-Year Retrospective Evaluation of Safety, Efficacy, and Patient Satisfaction in an Outpatient Setting
items.fact_zh: 80例SMAS折叠拉皮加颈阔肌成形在肿胀局麻下完成，10年随诊并发症10%，无全麻转归。
items.take_zh: 血肿2.5%、血清肿1.25%，比全麻组不差；但这是筛选过的ASA I-II、单术者。
items.scene_zh: 怕全麻、身体条件好的，拉皮可以在肿胀液下做，出血反而少。
items.fact_en: Eighty ASA I-II patients underwent SMAS plication facelift with platysmaplasty under tumescent local anesthesia over ten years, with a 10% complication rate (hematoma 2.5%) and no conversions to general anesthesia.
items.take_en: Those complication rates are respectable, but this is a single-surgeon series in selected ASA I-II patients, not a comparison against general anesthesia.
items.first_affil: Department of Medical, Surgical and Experimental Sciences, Plastic Surgery Unit, Sassari University Hospital Trust, University of Sassari, Sassari, Italy
